Lancet 1997; 350: 1115–16. Overdosage. Severe cardiac events have been associated with astemizole overdosage (see Arrhythmias, above); management is mainly supportive. The absorption of astemizole from the gas- trointestinal tract can be prevented by giving activated charcoal1 but because astemizole is rapidly absorbed it would need to be given as soon as possible after poisoning.
